name: Inmitsu Dakyoushi Saeko ~Mesu Dorei Choukyou Nisshi~
original_name: 淫蜜堕教師 冴子 ～雌奴隷調教日誌～
source:
A woman, studying under the holy profession of "teaching," is ridiculed by her students in this immoral collection!

In the Ryoko route, defile this pure flower of a woman; or, in the Saeko route, bring this haughty and arrogant woman down to earth.

Whichever you choose, it's up to you, the player!

[From [url=http://www.dlsite.com/ecchi-eng/work/=/product_id/RE035863.html]DLSite English[/url]]
translation:
一个在“教师”这一神圣职业下学习的女人，在这个不道德的收藏中被她的学生嘲笑！

凉子路线，玷污了这纯洁的女人之花；或者，在佐荣路线中，让这个傲慢自大的女人下凡。

无论你选择哪一个，都取决于你，玩家！

[来自[url=http://www.dlsite.com/ecchi-eng/work/=/product_id/RE035863.html]DLsite English[/url]]
